headline: AI Search Arms Race Heats Up: Competitors Push Discovery Innovation as Belgium Institutions Reassess Tools
bottomLine: Competitors are aggressively deploying AI-powered search and discovery capabilities, intensifying pressure on Elsevier to demonstrate superior research intelligence and workflow integration to retain Belgium institutional market share.
keyFindings: Competitor landscape is rapidly consolidating around AI-assisted discovery and search strategies, signaling that traditional abstract/citation databases alone are no longer sufficient differentiators.

Market momentum is shifting toward integrated research workspaces combining search, analysis, funding discovery, and writing assistance—the exact value proposition Elsevier is building with LeapSpace.
Belgium institutions face growing choice and pressure to evaluate next-generation research tools; sales urgency is high as customers actively benchmark alternatives before renewal cycles.
whyItMatters: This period marks a critical inflection point: AI-powered research discovery is now table-stakes, not premium. Elsevier's LeapSpace positioning—as an all-in-one workspace rather than point tools—becomes the primary sales narrative.
actionItems: Immediately audit Belgium institution renewal timelines and current tool stacks; prioritize accounts at risk of multi-tool replacement with competitive solutions before next procurement cycle.
Prepare LeapSpace demo materials and case studies emphasizing integrated workflow (search + funding + writing + analysis) vs.
Schedule customer advisory calls with 3–5 key Belgium institutions to understand AI search/discovery priorities and concerns; use findings to sharpen competitive positioning and product roadmap…
